slots.name: diamond count
slots.sentence: Austrian police are hunting two men alleged to have stolen a 200-carat platinum necklace encrusted with 673 diamonds that was on loan to a museum in Vienna and once belonged to Egyptian royalty.

slots.name: sale price
slots.sentence: The necklace was sold by Sotheby’s in New York in 2015 for $4.3m.

slots.name: exhibition works
slots.sentence: MAK said the piece had been snatched from a jewellery exhibition that had been on display since June, featuring more than 300 works by the French designers Van Cleef & Arpels.

slots.name: exhibition objects
slots.sentence: The MAK said the exhibition brought together about 200 “unique and rarely seen objects” from its own collection and pieces spanning the 120-year history of the Parisian jewellery house, from the Van Cleef & Arpels patrimonial collection.

events.label: MAK exhibition closed after necklace theft

slots.name: exhibition status
slots.sentence: A guided tour planned for Friday afternoon was listed as “cancelled” on the museum website and the exhibition, which was due to end on 27 September, was temporarily closed.
